description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_Munge, which extends the base filter class for URI manipulation within the HTMLPurifier library. It implements URI munging for security or obfuscation purposes, with methods to prepare the filter and process (filter) URIs based on specific configurations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_Munge
classes.description: A class for filtering and transforming URIs within the HTMLPurifier framework using URI munging techniques.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration settings, including target URI, parsing, embedding options, and secret key handling.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Processes a given URI, potentially transforming it according to the configured rules and security checks.

methods.name: makeReplace
methods.description: Generates replacement tokens for URI components used in the munging process.
